verdict.comment: The hat-trick seekers Private Island and ANTIQUITY both leave the impression there is more left in the tank.

comments.antiquity: Record in 1m handicaps is an impressive 12211; likely there's more to come; key player
comments.captainharry: No improvement for h'caps at Southwell 17 days ago; up in trip & still time to do better
comments.citylandscape: Non stayer over 1m3f/1m2f following promising 1m debut; turf/handicap debut
comments.groundsman: Ran well (sent off favourite) on nursery debut in September; first run over 1m; unexposed
comments.harswellruby: Improved 2nd at Beverley last week and she's 2lb well in; unexposed at 1m; contender
comments.masterofzest: Promise in three of his four starts; gelded since 5th on handicap debut; new headgar here
comments.maywedance: Well beaten at 33-1 on last month's handicap debut (1m2f); others bring stronger claims
comments.privateisland: 2-2 in handicaps; up 6lb for latest win but still learning her craft and high on the list
comments.seedinvestor: Didn't threaten on recent reappearance/stable debut; headgear off; improvement needed
comments.spaceraider: The odd promising run at two; needs improvement to trouble the principals; yard run two
comments.thelostcanvas: Ran poorly on soft when last seen; first 2 runs were better but not obviously well treated
comments.zarathos: Went close on recent turf debut and closely matched with reopposing winner Antiquity

races.raceComment: antiquity is marginally preferred with a score of 48.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more reliable profile over privateisland. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 3/10 at doncaster. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.ayeuptom: Well beaten in both starts over 7f on good ground/AW; little appeal

comments.flameofforest: Worth monitoring in the market, but he makes his debut in a potentially warm contest
comments.moutai: Showed some ability in both starts last October; may show more in handicaps after this
comments.moyowasi: Makes debut in a useful contest, but is nicely bred; market support would be interesting
comments.musicoftime: Won a 16-runner maiden on second start over C&D in October; much respected on this return
comments.remmooz: Faces a stiff task on debut, but market support should be noted
comments.riverking: Plenty of promise when fourth on his Kempton debut last August; respected on his return
comments.roaringtwenties: Promising third behind a smart sort on his Kempton debut this month; major player
comments.seaforce: Fourth on his Newmarket debut last September, albeit 18l behind the winner
comments.sogannie: Both starts at Newcastle, showing some ability in the first; this looks a tough task

verdict.comment: This month's Yarmouth 1-2 MARMOGA and Spanish Mane appeal most, although Danzart is one to keep a close eye on.

comments.carltonandco: Infrequent winner but ended 2024 in good form on AW; stays 7f but perhaps best at shorter
comments.clipshamlahabana: Two 6f wins in late 2022 but drawn a blank since; hopes rest on drop to Class 6 reviving
comments.create: C&D win off 14lb higher last summer; back to form when third at Southwell latest; chance
comments.danzart: On losing run but couldn't have been more eyecatching at Newcastle latest; hood stays off
comments.diligenthenry: Ready win in a 7f AW handicap 18 days ago; up 6lb and has to prove himself on turf
comments.gamblerskitty: Eight-race maiden; bits of form that make him of interest; first run for six months
comments.marmoga: Made winning turf/h'cap debut at Yarmouth, getting up late; now tried in cheekpieces
comments.ratafia: Returns on a feasible mark but he was disappointing when favourite in this race last year
comments.spanishmane: Multiple winner; picked off late by Marmoga at Yarmouth; should be sharper for the run
comments.toughatthetop: Yet to progress in two handicap runs but today's longer trip could have a positive effect
comments.travis: On the downgrade but handicapped accordingly; sharper for recent return; check betting

verdict.comment: Neil Mulholland's ALRIGHT DAI was on the up at the turn of the year and can resume his progress to land the hat-trick.

comments.alrightdai: Absent for 113 days but on the up when last seen and has good claims in the hat-trick bid
comments.atlanticpower: Showed a bit more the last twice but needs to step up again on this drop back in trip
comments.clintonlane: He's struggled since falling at Fakenham in December and others hold greater appeal
comments.decorated: Better back over hurdles and he was second over C&D last time; looks solid
comments.greydalco: Went the wrong way over hurdles and pulled up in all four of his chases; absent for a year
comments.imyourbuckaroo: Good effort penultimate start but poor last time and blinkers need to bounce him back
comments.lowexpectations: 2m7f a possible excuse last time but well behind Decorated two starts back; work to do
comments.misueno: 12lb below his last winning mark but he's shown little for over a year (hurdles and AW)
comments.midnightjewel: C&D winner; below form in the autumn and finished last of 7 finishers at Bangor last night
comments.mycullen: Handicap debutant, best effort two starts back; no surprise to see him go well
comments.ovalstreet: 3-11 in points but 0-10 under rules and something for another new trainer after a layoff
comments.redwindsor: Struggled last year but well handicapped now and needs a close market check on this return
comments.simontheseagull: Ground query but the yard's in form and he's unexposed; not ruled out

races.raceComment: midnightjewel is marginally preferred with a score of 55.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over clintonlane. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 8 wins from 28 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 8/28 at fontwell. Key attributes include optimal distance, though inconsistent profile need consideration.
